liveDecisions.decision: Library is a normal consumer plus donor/regression oracle; generic improvements must be implemented centrally and propagate to every applicable surface, not patched Library-only.
Reuse means Presentation + Behavior + Interaction + Functionality, not semantics alone. Writers must not locally reinvent any shared dimension.
Acceptance is based on the actual visible and interactable result: appearance, interaction, functionality, responsive behavior, Bidi/accessibility and truthful state/data.
Every material component counts, including small controls, icons/affordances, tree items, menus, toolbars, content chrome, states, transients and panes.
Controller is accountable for mission design, scope isolation, falsification, convergence and acceptance. Writer PASS never transfers that responsibility.

Mandatory review chain: Writer → Independent Audit → exact source/scope audit → Browser/Runtime comparison → Owner-Decisions audit → Reuse/duplicate-owner audit → data/provider truth audit → integrated regression → Acceptance/Correction.
Every Owner decision and applicable enhancement must have explicit zero-loss disposition. Long chats or missing Writer mentions may never erase a decision.
ChatGPT Project static instructions must use stable live pointers/read sets and must not hardcode changing epochs, hashes, active missions or readiness counts.
Every substantive CEP Controller response must refresh the live governance/current-state set and applicable Owner decisions instead of relying on chat memory.
Before classifying, modifying, archiving or deleting governance artifacts, inspect their content recursively where material; never infer authority/value from filenames alone.
Historical files may contain durable laws, lessons and accepted-value evidence. Distill useful knowledge while preventing historical state from becoming current authority.

Future Writers should receive small bounded tasks and mostly compose/configure/bind/test prebuilt reusable owners; generic design/behavior/presentation invention belongs in Foundation correction, not Surface Writer discretion.

Where applicable, compare reused components step-by-step against current Owner decisions and accepted runtime/donor value across presentation, behavior, interaction, responsive states and accessibility—not only broad screenshots.

`/Google Drive/cep_building_mgm` is the durable CEP governance/control workspace and should contain the live pointers, Controller operating rules, decision indices, evidence maps, review protocols and execution custody needed to reconstruct state without chat memory.

CEP live project/control truth must reside in one stable `/Google Drive/cep_building_mgm/00_CONTROLLER/CURRENT_STATE.md` file updated in place. Do not create new version-numbered CURRENT_CONTROL files for ordinary progression; existing versions are historical lineage only.

Any Controller that materially changes or newly establishes mission/stage, Writer/Auditor status, blockers, accepted authority, readiness/build authorization, stack/release state or next authorized action must update CURRENT_STATE.md in the same task before replying, then re-read it from Google Drive.

Canonical governance files use stable names and in-place updates. New governance files are admitted only for a genuinely distinct semantic/machine-readable role. Overlapping governance documents must be read, zero-loss distilled into the canonical file, and archived rather than proliferated.

Project static instructions must force every substantive Controller response to refresh CURRENT_STATE, canonical governance, applicable Owner decisions and exact task sources; they must be strong enough that a new or long-running Controller does not depend on chat memory or miss a material rule hidden in scattered files.

Direct Owner visual rejection of a Presentation result immediately invalidates lower Writer/Auditor Presentation PASS/READY tokens for that result and blocks convergence/promotion until corrected and re-proven.
liveDecisions.notes: Applies immediately to E19 visual rejection.

liveDecisions.decision: Fixture/demo/synthetic consumers may support testing but never satisfy real-consumer Presentation reuse, donor parity, second-consumer or cutover acceptance.

For accepted donor generic Presentation, reuse means extract/refactor actual accepted value into the canonical owner and rebind the donor; building a parallel simplified/lookalike implementation is not extraction.
For each applicable component/state not explicitly superseded, accepted donor value is the minimum quality/value floor. Materially weaker/thin/partial/unproven Presentation is a blocking failure.

Controller must grant/serialize the real source seams needed to achieve an extraction mission. It is forbidden to prohibit the true donor/runtime seam and accept a fixture/parallel substitute instead.
Presentation acceptance requires component-by-component donor-vs-candidate proof on real consumer paths at matching states and viewports, including 1440 and approximately 1024 where applicable.

Any unresolved BLOCKING/QUALITY_BLOCKER/MISSING_SHARED_FOUNDATION/PARTIAL_FOUNDATION/materially weaker/thin/not donor-grade/not zero-loss/unproven applicable finding forbids PASS/READY/convergence until directly resolved or explicitly superseded by Owner.

E19 A/B/C/D Presentation candidates and E19_PARALLEL_LANES_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_CONVERGENCE are rejected for Presentation acceptance by Owner visual review. Do not execute Lane F convergence. Salvage only independently adjudicated subordinate value.

Before any Presentation acceptance, Controller must directly inspect and expose an Owner-readable component/state evidence sheet. Evidence hidden only inside ZIPs/reports is insufficient acceptance workflow.

Top-level readiness/acceptance may never exceed the worst unresolved applicable row/finding. 'Materially addressed', 'bounded scope' or 'Controller later' cannot downgrade a blocker without direct closure evidence.

Historical planning/owner-lock matrices are durable collision evidence, not current mission authority. Reconcile them with current source and Owner decisions before use; if a lock blocks the true objective, serialize the hotspot rather than invent a substitute.
The sole live CEP governance/execution custody root is /Google Drive/cep_building_mgm. File Library CEP paths are retired from live operation after zero-loss migration verification.

liveDecisions.decision: All live CURRENT_STATE, governance, Writer/Auditor inputs, outputs, Controller inboxes, accepted-successor custody and future mission paths must use the Google Drive CEP root and be maintained there in place.

Library-era absolute CEP paths embedded in immutable historical receipts, reports or evidence are historical provenance only. They must not be rewritten when doing so would falsify what the evidence recorded, and they never authorize a current launch path.

The CEP management tree must migrate to Google Drive with zero file loss and preserved relative structure. Retire the File Library source only after destination verification proves the moved corpus is complete; failed moves remain source-side until retried.

Supporting census/manifests/stale registers/inventories/maps/pointers never create current state, accepted implementation, Owner, launch, readiness or promotion authority. Any conflict with the live authority chain is stale and must be corrected before mission launch or acceptance.

liveDecisions.decision: CEP is a personal/local single-owner product. Prioritize the best functional, visual and practical result on the Owner's local machine. Exact dependency/tool versions or production-grade reproducibility are not blocking by themselves; substitutions are allowed when they preserve compatibility, data integrity and equal-or-better result quality. Keep the stack as simple as practical, but admit an additional tool when it materially improves the result.

liveDecisions.decision: No historical/superseded INPUT, START_HERE, CURRENT_AUTHORITY, AUTHORIZED, READY, launch packet, Writer prompt, correction packet, release authority or execution manifest is launchable merely because it exists or contains self-authorizing text. A mission may launch only when CURRENT_STATE explicitly authorizes the mission class and the Controller binds the exact current mission/path/parent under current governance.

liveDecisions.decision: A mutating Writer works only in an isolated private candidate derived from the exact Controller-approved parent and never mutates an accepted successor in place. Overlapping/shared-hotspot candidates are accepted sequentially through Controller-controlled rebase/replay/integration and full re-verification; parallel mutation never writes to one canonical working tree.

liveDecisions.decision: CEP visual/browser evidence must treat local-process reachability, browser process launch, browser URL navigation, rendering, screenshot creation, and actual image inspection as separate capabilities. Before declaring visual capture blocked, use the bounded local/offline recovery ladder, including explicit executable paths, navigation-independent exact-current-candidate rendering where provenance is exact, validated offline browser packages, standalone Chrome Headless Shell after full-Chrome container failure, and other already-available compatible engines as applicable. Do not modify product architecture merely to obtain screenshots, and never relabel historical screenshots as fresh current-candidate evidence.
liveDecisions.notes: Restored after a concurrent Controller refresh was detected. Current live state already cites OD-20260915-038; shared CEP_VISUAL_CAPTURE_RECOVERY_PROTOCOL.md carries the durable technical procedure.

liveDecisions.decision: Launch the maximum number of genuinely independent isolated Writers from the same exact accepted parent when the dependency/collision graph permits; do not artificially serialize Writer execution merely because review or acceptance will be batched. Partition convergence and independent review into coherent bounded groups based on shared owners/hotspots when scale warrants it. Each grouped audit must still adjudicate every candidate/delta explicitly; convergence may replay only Controller-approved deltas; each converged group requires independent post-convergence verification, followed by final integrated cross-group regression/audit.
liveDecisions.notes: Controller chooses group boundaries from exact source/owner/collision topology; same-file work may run as isolated candidates only when function/region ownership and invariants are proven disjoint. No ZIP overlay.

liveDecisions.decision: Temporary Owner exceptions, one-off waivers, situational allowances, or narrow carve-outs are operational only for their exact scope and must NOT be registered or promoted as durable Owner decisions, reusable authority, governance law, or precedent unless the Owner explicitly authorizes that recording. Normal CURRENT_STATE, acceptance, readiness, launch, blocker, and implementation-authority updates caused by actual project progress remain mandatory and are unaffected.
liveDecisions.notes: Meta-governance rule governing future exception intake. One-off exceptions may be applied to their exact task without becoming durable authority.

liveDecisions.decision: Any substantial CEP Heavy Chat must, on explicit Owner checkpoint request, materialize a self-contained source-bound continuity package that preserves the exact coherent working candidate, hashes, applied-change/finding/phase ledgers, evidence index, revalidation/invalidation map, input consumption, Owner-decision progress and exact resume instructions so a fresh chat can continue from verified work without reconstructing chat history or blindly redoing completed work. The checkpoint never overrides newer live authority and stale proof must be rerun only when invalidated by subsequent source/state changes or by mandatory final integrated gates.
liveDecisions.notes: Durable Owner continuity requirement. Technical procedure is maintained in HEAVY_CHAT_CONTINUITY_CHECKPOINT_PROTOCOL.md.

liveDecisions.decision: Optimize CEP parallel execution for maximum useful/value-weighted parallelism, not maximum Writer count. Choose the smallest number of coherent independent execution lanes that minimizes time-to-accepted-result while preserving quality, scope isolation and safe collision control. Do not fragment coherent work into many tiny Writers when fewer Writers or Controller-owned bounded execution achieves equal or better throughput. Use expected work size/duration, dependency/collision DAG, review/integration overhead and evidence burden to choose lane count.
liveDecisions.notes: Clarifies OD-20260915-039: safe parallelism remains preferred when useful, but Writer count is not the objective. Fewer coherent lanes or direct Controller correction are correct when coordination overhead would dominate.

lineageOutsideLiveCount.decision: Browser/local visual evidence execution must treat local-process reachability, browser URL navigation, browser process launch, browser rendering, screenshot creation, and actual image inspection as separate capabilities. A failure in one capability must not be used to declare visual capture impossible while another bounded local/offline path remains viable. Before an infrastructure blocker, use the governed recovery ladder without modifying product architecture merely to obtain screenshots; fresh evidence must remain exact-current-candidate evidence.
lineageOutsideLiveCount.notes: Includes explicit-browser-path, navigation-independent rendering, bounded cache/tool discovery, validated offline browser packages, standalone Chrome Headless Shell, and other already-available compatible engines when applicable. Consolidated under pre-existing concurrent Owner decision OD-20260915-038 after Controller re-refresh; preserved for lineage only.

lineageOutsideLiveCount.decision: When browser URL navigation to localhost/file transport is blocked by environment policy but browser rendering is available, CEP may use an in-memory browser transport such as page.setContent for visual/browser evidence only when it renders the exact current candidate generated/self-contained bytes and exact required state, is bound to the final candidate/source identity, and is not a fixture/lookalike. If the browser cannot reach localhost but a local process can, exact current local data/assets may be fetched by that local process and injected with provenance. Transport substitution never relaxes freshness, real-product semantics, state/viewport parity, or candidate identity.
lineageOutsideLiveCount.notes: Formalizes the already-proven R3 in-memory transport pattern while preventing historical-image or fixture substitution. Consolidated under pre-existing concurrent Owner decision OD-20260915-038 after Controller re-refresh; preserved for lineage only.
